LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_7_Text: The family has separated. Those who stayed have gone their own ways; those who left are still on the road. Suin has written to ask after them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_8_Text: There has been no clear news of the family for some time. Suin has asked travelers to inquire, but only scattered rumors have come back.

LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_HiredWorkerDurati: How long a long-term Ratkin worker remains before leaving. Minimum 5 days; maximum 10 years.

LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Narrative_OpeningText:
"My name is Suin. Some news from your settlement reaches me. Slowly, and not always accurately.

There are more Ratkin on the roads lately. Some seek food, some trade, and some steal. Do not let them through your gates just because I wrote to you. I cannot vouch for them.

When I hear how things turn out, I will write again."
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Narrative_ProgressText:
"News of {0} kinds of visitors has reached me.

I keep separate records of those who arrived and those who found a home. Someone who came in healthy may not leave that way. Someone who came to steal may end up staying.

You need not write back just for my sake. I will wait for further news."
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Narrative_RewardText:
"The silver is from me. All {0} of it.

I asked someone to take a detour. He complained that such a small delivery was not worth the journey. When he returned, he asked when the next trip would be. I have not promised him one.

The money is yours now. Use it where it is needed. You need not take anyone in to repay me."
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GuanyinTuSatiety_Status: Guanyin clay satiety: {0}/{1} uses; {2} days left this time.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_EntryText: A mother with Ratkin plague has arrived with three babies, a little Guanyin clay, some components and silver. They are near the drop-off point. You can take them in, ask them to leave, or leave the original arrival arrangements in place.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_AcceptMessage: You have taken in the mother and her babies. Find them shelter, then decide how to treat the plague.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_RejectMessage: You did not take them in. The mother is leaving, but the babies remain on the map.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_1_Text: The mother did not survive, but at least one of her children did. They have grown up in your care. Suin has recorded the outcome.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_2_Text: The mother and her children survived. The children are no longer babies, and they still share a roof. Suin has recorded it.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_3_Text: The mother died. Her surviving children were imprisoned or enslaved. Suin offered no comment; she only recorded what happened.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_4_Text: Neither the mother nor her children survived. Suin's record ends here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_5_Text: The mother and her children have left. Suin is still asking travelers for news of them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_6_Label: Suin: the children she could not save
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_6_Text: The mother survived, but not all her children did. She keeps walking, as if she still does not know where to take them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_4_Message: The mother and her children did not survive.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_Revisit_Text: Your caravan has encountered {0} on the road. They neither approach nor flee. They wait for you to decide what to do this time.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_Revisit_RescueUnavail: The caravan does not have enough silver.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_Revisit_IgnoreMessage: You did not stop. The caravan continues on its way.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_Revisit_RescueMessage: You paid the silver and brought them into your caravan. A gift of thanks is still four years away.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_Revisit_KillMessage: It is only a story... isn't it?
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N004_Revisit_RewardText: A promise made four years ago has been kept. Suin has sent {0} silver to the colony's trade drop-off point.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N005_Accepted_Text: The children are in your care now. The trader checked the exchanged goods once more, as though afraid someone might call him back.\n\nNobody mentioned the price again. Someone still has to feed the children and find them beds. None of that was written into the deal.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N005_Rejected_Text: The trader packed away the goods. You did not change your answer, so he stopped waiting.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N005_TimedOut_Text: The agreed time passed without a reply. The trader is gathering the children and preparing to leave. The exchange is over.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N005_Broken_Text: The handover was never completed. The agreed terms no longer stand, and those still alive are no longer bound by them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_EntryText:
A small hole has appeared near your food stores, with crumbs caught around its edge.

Some want it filled immediately. Others think following the trail might recover what went missing.

While left open, the hole costs at most one unit of food per day, up to three in total.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_ForceClean: Clear it by force (lose up to 5 food)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_Ignore: Leave it alone (lose the trail after 3 days)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_Bait_Message: Food has been left beside the hole. There will be one less portion tonight.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_Bait_NoFood: There is no food available to leave.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_BaitReadyText: The bait is gone, and fresh marks lead away from the hole. You can follow them or stop here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_ActionFailed: This granary report can no longer be acted on.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_Ignore_Message: You left the movement beneath the granary alone for now.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_Sealed_Message: You sealed the hole near the granary.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_ForceCleaned_Message: You cleared the hole near the granary by force.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_BaitLost_Message: You stopped following. The bait's destination remains unknown.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_BaitTraced_Message: You followed the bait's trail to a new location.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_Sealed_Text: The hole is filled. No more food will be lost through this gap.\n\nNobody went to see who was on the other side.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_BaitTraced_Text: You marked a place at the end of the trail. Someone will still have to go there to see what is inside.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_BaitLost_Text: You did not continue the search. The hole has been dealt with, and this trail goes no farther.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_ForceCleaned_Text: You searched every hiding place around the hole. The scattered food you swept out could no longer be eaten.\n\nAt least nobody needs to watch this gap tonight.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_LostClue_Text: The hole or the original food store can no longer be traced. This lead ends here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N006_BaitTraced_SiteText: You followed scattered food to a location. It may be a hidden store, or merely the start of another trail.

LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EnableGnawing_Too: Hungry Ratkin without food may gnaw on walls or tree bark.

LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EnableExperimenta: Hungry Ratkin prisoners without food may bite the natural tails of sleeping or helpless Ratkin prisoners under age 3. A bite can sever the tail.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_ChaosPregnancyEna: Eligible Ratkin sharing a room may become pregnant at the chosen interval and chance.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EnableExperimenta: Newborn Ratkin whose mother carries famine genes inherit her status in your colony: prisoner, slave or colonist. Other births are unchanged.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_RatEggTraitBridge: Allow additional traits for Ratkin young
Young famine Ratkin may receive additional traits from the base game and supported trait mods.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_CompatDisabledHin: Additional traits from supported mods are disabled.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EnablePawnHistori: Enable character histories for event-generated Ratkin
When enabled, eligible event-generated Ratkin may receive one of the selected histories. Enabled by default.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_PawnHistory_Selec: Select the histories that may be assigned. The master switch above must also be enabled.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_EnablePawnTraits_: When enabled, eligible event-generated Ratkin may receive one of the selected traits. A higher weight makes that trait more likely. A weight of 0 is never chosen. Enabled by default.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_PawnTrait_Selecti: Select the traits that may be assigned and set their weights. The master switch above must also be enabled.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_PawnTrait_Weight_: Higher weights are more likely to be chosen. 0 means this trait is never assigned.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_PawnTrait_History: May appear with matching character histories
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Settings_ImplNote: Choose how Ratkin arrive, behave and become part of your colony's story.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PrisonerScavenge_Text_Floo: Tummy's rumbling... even dusty crumbs count.
Mud all round my mouth. Still licking.
Little cracks hide little crumbs. I'll find them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PrisonerScavenge_Text_Dirt: Dirty water, dirty scraps... can't be picky.
You think it's nasty? I'm just a hungry little Ratkin.
Face all muddy, tummy a little happier.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PrisonerScavenge_Text_Vomi: Smelly, bubbling mess... lick it all up.
You threw it up. I'll find a use for it.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PrisonerScavenge_Text_Amni: Slippery stuff at my mouth... gulp, gulp.
Sticky and awful. Still got to eat.
Whatever's on the floor. Just make the hunger stop.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PrisonerScavenge_Text_Bloo: A precious mouthful. Lick the floor clean.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PrisonerScavenge_Text_Pois: Tummy all twisted. Still want to lick.
Bitter throat, crying on the floor... can't stop.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Beg_Text_Success_2: Thank you... thank you for the food...
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBite_Text_Start_1: Creep over and bite that tail...
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBite_Text_Start_2: Such a long tail... just one bite...
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBite_Text_Start_3: Only a little... maybe they won't wake up...
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TailBite_Text_Failed_2: Didn't get it. Got hurt instead...

LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_EntryText: Some visitors have Ratkin plague. The group has stopped nearby. The patients need treatment and somewhere to rest.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_RecoveryText: Those who remain no longer show signs of Ratkin plague. It is time to decide what comes next.\n\nYou can let them leave or welcome the recovered visitors into your colony.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_ActionFailed: The visitors' situation has changed. This choice is no longer available.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_VisitorControlBlocked: These visitors are in quarantine. Resolve the quarantine letter first.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Quarantine_Message: Kept {0} patients here for now. They still need care, not merely orders to stay.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Release_Message: Departure has been arranged for {0} patients. Those unable to travel are still waiting.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Defer_Message: You chose not to intervene. The patients' condition will still be followed.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Recovered_Message: The recovered visitors are no longer here. Their quarantine record is closed.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_RecoveredRelease_Mess: Arranged for {0} recovered visitors to leave.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Recovered_Text: The recovered visitors have left. This time, they need not carry the plague with them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_RecoveredStayed_Text: The recovered visitors have stayed in the colony. Their hospital beds are empty; they still need homes.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Released_Text: The patients allowed to leave have left the map. Their condition beyond it is unknown.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_QuarantineBroken_Text: Some patients left before recovering. The remaining visitors are no longer ordered to stay.\n\nThe quarantine failed. Where those who left have gone cannot be seen from here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Died_Text: None of these patients survived. The quarantine is over.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_N007_Handled_Text: The patients have gone their separate ways. News of some still arrives; others have not been heard from. Suin has put away the old list.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_SuccessorNotice_Text: Development of Ratkin: Great Famine Year has moved to Ratkin: Hunger and Havoc.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_SuccessorNotice_Search: You can also find it by searching for Ratkin: Hunger and Havoc.
